text:
sofia: Postmortem follow-up thread for the KV-shard OOMs we saw in prod yesterday. Postmortem here: https://redwood.internal/pm/kv-oom-2026-03-22. TL;DR recurring fragmentation + sticky residency. Below are concrete owners, short timeline, and immediate mitigation tasks.

raj: I'll take profiling and heap capture work. Plan: run continuous pprof on canaries, collect 30s heap profiles during spikes, add allocation traces. Opening INF-4827. ETA 2026-03-25.

tara: I'll own eviction/soft-limit experiments and the eviction policy test harness. Creating INF-4831 with experiment matrix (LRU vs TTL-boost vs size-based). ETA 2026-03-27.

mike: I can drive GC/config tuning. First pass: lower slab page size, enable more-frequent incremental GC, and test `--max-inflight-keys` drops. I'll post a config diff and perf numbers. INF-4832. ETA 2026-03-29.

ops-bot: Reminder: "OOM remediation sync" scheduled: 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC. Meeting link: https://meet.internal/oom-sync

raj: Quick note on instrumentation: need a small script to sample kv residency histograms and kv entry age. Will add to INF-4827 and attach a reproducible harness.

sofia: Also we must tweak alerts so we get earlier signal. Proposal: move eviction threshold from 90%% to 85%% for soft-alerts, keep hard at 95%%. @tara can you file the PR?

tara: Yep. I'll open the alert PR in #monitoring and include a dashboard with event-correlated heap-alloc graphs.

mike: When we hit a repro, we'll capture core + heap: command to run on host: ```sudo gcore -o /tmp/core.$(date +%s) $PID``` and then `pprof --text /path/to/binary /tmp/core.<ts>` for quick triage.

jen: I can provision temporary extra shard capacity in Dedicated for the canary lanes if you need headroom for experiments. Tell me which cluster.

raj: I'll prototype the CI regression test for sticky-residency growth (synthetic workload that exercises long-lived prefixes). If it looks stable I'll add it to the pre-merge suite. PR by 3/25.

sofia: Action checklist (short):
1) INF-4827 - profiling + pprof captures (raj) - due 2026-03-25
2) INF-4831 - eviction experiments & alert PR (tara) - due 2026-03-27
3) INF-4832 - GC/config tuning (mike) - due 2026-03-29
4) CI regression prototype (raj) - due 2026-03-25
5) Dedicated canary capacity (jen) - on-demand, coordinate with raj
6) Postmortem doc update with actions + timelines (sofia) - due 2026-03-26

tara: :thumbsup: I'll update INF-4831 with concrete knobs and measurement dashboard.

ops-bot: Follow-up reminder set for 48h.

sofia: Also note pattern: spikes often follow our large-batch reroutes (last two incidents). Action: add a short runbook item to avoid large flurry reroutes during peak eviction windows. I'll add that to the postmortem doc.

raj: One more: I'll include memory allocation heatmaps from perf and the jemalloc stats dump (`jeprof`/`mallctl`) for the first profiling snapshot.

mike: If eviction experiments don't reduce tail OOMs we'll try an aggressive short-term mitigator: `--eviction-probation=on` + lower KV TTLs for non-critical keys. We can roll as a canary.

sofia: Great. If you hit blockers ping me directly. We will use the sync to reassign any overdue items. Thanks everyone.
